concerns.text: The test KnowledgeFirstCredentialTransmissionTest makes an unauthenticated call to /api/v1/auth/sso/moodle which returns 401 without executing fallback password generation, making the DB assertion pass trivially or indirectly.
The PR includes Flyway migration V20260917055958328__add_gqm_metric_to_telemetry.sql which is outside the scope of knowledge-first credential transmission QA.
In frontend/serve.mjs, the order of route condition checks for 'non-existent' and 'unauthorized' was swapped, which does not affect behavior but is an unnecessary diff line.
